name: Wheat Town Native Unity Prototype
implementedFeatures: town hub with plots, buildings, residents, harvest table and order board
task page with farm order, resident commissions and daily route
harvest mini-game entered from the town scene
knownLimitations: Basic runtime UI is generated by script rather than authored prefabs.
Advanced animations such as resource fly-to-bar and smoke particles are still pending.
Dairy building is a visible first-version placeholder; cheese recipe is reserved.
